m.s: In a bowl, mix {pork_mince} with {lemongrass}, {garlic*0.5} (finely grated), {fishsauce*0.5}, {brownsugar*0.5} and plenty of pepper. Roll into small flat patties about 5cm across.

Mix the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the juice of {lime}, the rest of the garlic, sliced {chilli} and 2 tbsp water per serve. Stir until the sugar dissolves. Taste it: it should be salty, sweet and sour all at once.
Cook {vermicelli} in boiling water for 3 to 4 minutes (check the packet), then rinse under cold water until cool and drain really well.
Shred {cos}. Cut {cucumber} and {carrot} into matchsticks. Pick the leaves from {mint} and {coriander}, and roughly crush {peanuts}.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties in batches for 3 minutes a side until caramelised and cooked through.
Divide the noodles between bowls and top with the salad, pork, herbs and peanuts. Pour the nuoc cham over at the table.

l: A great cold lunch. Pack the dressing separately and pour it on just before eating. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: Naturally gluten free with rice noodles. Check the fish sauce label.
